description.describe_ch: 本課程主要在探討審計實務與學術界所面臨與需要進一步研究之課題，包括審計品質、會計師超然獨立性、審計任期、產業專家、審計公費、審計風險與公司治理等，本課程有助於學生對審計環境之認識及奠定未來審計研究發展之基礎。
description.describe_eh: This course is designed for understanding the practice issues and with respect to some topics research in auditing, such as audit quality, auditor independence, audit tenure, industry specialization, audit fees and corporate governance etc. The course is helpful for students in understanding current audit environment and as the basis of future audit research.

targets.describe_ch: 回顧審計實務以便找出所欲面對的問題，並分析審計環境所面臨的問題與挑戰
targets.describe_en: Recall the audit approach in practice to link the issues to be faced. Analyzing the issues surrounding the auditing environment and challenges

targets.describe_ch: 整合學術與實務上對這些問題的爭論，分析在審計研究上重要主題，並應用於未來研究
targets.describe_en: Integrate the debate over the issues or topics have been discussed in practice and academy. Analyzing important issues to be engaged in further study or research in Auditing.

targets.describe_ch: 彙總國際審計市場之概況，瞭解國際期刊有關審計領域之相關研究重點
targets.describe_en: Summarize the overview of the international audit market and understand the relevant research in the audit field of international journals

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
為了確保良好的學習環境與成效，我們希望大家能遵守以下課堂禮儀和網路禮儀：

課堂實體空間：

準時到達課堂，尊重教學時間。
專心聆聽，尊重教授和同學的發言。
提問或討論時，保持禮貌並尊重不同觀點。
手機靜音，避免打擾他人。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
In order to ensure a good learning environment and effectiveness, we hope that everyone will abide by the following classroom etiquette and online etiquette:

Classroom physical space:

Arrive at class on time and respect teaching time.
Listen attentively and respect what professors and classmates have to say.
When asking questions or discussing, be polite and respectful of different viewpoints.
Silence your cell phone to avoid disturbing others.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
• ◎Academic Integrity
    Per university policy, students shall not plagiarize, cheat, or falsify or misuse academic records. Students are expected to adhere to University policy on cheating and plagiarism in all courses. The minimum penalty for a first offense is a zero on the assignment on which the offense occurred. If the offense is considered severe or the student has other academic offenses on their record, more serious penalties, up to suspension from the university may be imposed.
    Plagiarism and cheating are serious breaches of academic conduct. When students submit work purporting to be their own, but which in any way borrows ideas, organization, wording or anything else from another source without appropriate acknowledgement of the fact, the students are guilty of plagiarism. Plagiarism includes reproducing someone else’s work, whether it be a published article, chapter of a book, a paper from a friend or some file, or something similar to this. Plagiarism includes the practice of employing or allowing another person to alter or revise the work which a student submits as his/her own, whoever that other person may be.
 
  • ◎Disclaimer
    All policies discussed herein are subject to the official University Regulations. If there is a discrepancy between and of our policies and the University policies, the official policies shall reign. Also, we reserve the right to modify any part of this syllabus to your advantage during the semester after giving adequate notice of such changes (e.g. extend due dates).
